window.__haugastolConsentState = { analytics: false, marketing: false };
window.gtag = window.gtag || function(){window.dataLayer.push(arguments);};
window.gtag('consent', 'default', {
  'analytics_storage': 'denied',
  'ad_storage': 'denied',
  'ad_user_data': 'denied',
  'ad_personalization': 'denied',
  'wait_for_update': 500
});
window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'consent_default_denied' });
(function(){
  function clearCookies(prefixes) {
    var hostname = window.location.hostname;
    var labels = hostname.split('.');
    var parentDomain = labels.length > 2 ? '.' + labels.slice(-2).join('.') : '';
    var domains = ['', hostname, '.' + hostname, parentDomain];
    var names = document.cookie.split(';').map(function(part) {
      return decodeURIComponent((part.split('=')[0] || '').trim());
    });
    names.forEach(function(name) {
      if (!name || !prefixes.some(function(prefix) {
        return name === prefix || name.indexOf(prefix) === 0;
      })) return;
      domains.forEach(function(domain) {
        var domainPart = domain ? '; Domain=' + domain : '';
        document.cookie = encodeURIComponent(name) + '=; Max-Age=0; Path=/' + domainPart + '; SameSite=Lax';
      });
    });
  }
  try {
    var raw = window.localStorage.getItem("haugastol_consent_v2");
    if (!raw) return;
    var stored = JSON.parse(raw);
    var valid =
      stored &&
      stored.version === 2 &&
      stored.policyVersion === "2026-10-05" &&
      stored.copyVersion === "2026-10-05" &&
      typeof stored.receiptId === 'string' &&
      stored.receiptId.length >= 16 &&
      typeof stored.createdAt === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(stored.createdAt) &&
      typeof stored.updatedAt === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(stored.updatedAt) &&
      typeof stored.expiresAt === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(stored.expiresAt) &&
      stored.expiresAt > Date.now() &&
      stored.necessary === true &&
      typeof stored.analytics === 'boolean' &&
      typeof stored.marketing === 'boolean';
    if (!valid) {
      window.localStorage.removeItem("haugastol_consent_v2");
      return;
    }
    if (!stored.analytics) clearCookies(['_ga', '_gid', '_gat']);
    if (!stored.marketing) clearCookies(['_gcl_', '_gac_', '_fbp', '_fbc']);
    var restored = {
      analytics_storage: stored.analytics ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      ad_storage: stored.marketing ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      ad_user_data: stored.marketing ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      ad_personalization: stored.marketing ? 'granted' : 'denied'
    };
    window.__haugastolConsentState = {
      analytics: stored.analytics,
      marketing: stored.marketing
    };
    window.gtag('consent', 'update', restored);
    window.dataLayer.push({
      event: 'consent_restored',
      consent_analytics: stored.analytics,
      consent_marketing: stored.marketing,
      consent_version: 'v2'
    });
  } catch (_) {}

space-y-6"><h1 class="text-5xl font-medium leading-[0.93] tracking-tight md:text-[5.35rem] lg:text-[6.1rem]">Snowkiting in Haugastøl</h1><p class="max-w-2xl text-base text-white/90 md:text-[1.18rem]">Haugastøl is widely recognized as one of the best spots in the world for snowkiting. The Hardangervidda mountain plateau offers huge areas and stable wind conditions throughout the entire winter.</p><a class="inline-flex rounded-none bg-white px-8 py-3 text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-[#16120f]" style="color:#16120f" href="/en/booking?src_interest=snowkite_accommodation">Book now</a></div></div></section><section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1240px] px-6 pb-8 md:pb-12"><div class="grid items-start gap-8 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_280px]"><div class="space-y-10 md:space-y-12"><details class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-4 md:hidden"><summary class="cursor-pointer text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[#6a645d]">Contents</summary><ul class="mt-3 space-y-2"><li><a href="#nar-er-forholdene-best" class="text-sm text-[#1d1916] hover:underline">When is the best time to come?</a></li><li><a href="#lokalkunnskap" class="text-sm text-[#1d1916] hover:underline">Local knowledge</a></li><li><a href="#hvorfor-haugastol" class="text-sm text-[#1d1916] hover:underline">Why Haugastol?</a></li><li><a href="#blaser-det-alltid" class="text-sm text-[#1d1916] hover:underline">Is it always windy?</a></li><li><a href="#villrein-soner" class="text-sm text-[#1d1916] hover:underline">Reindeer and restrictions</a></li><li><a href="#finnes-det-noe-annet-a-gjore-pa-haugastol-enn-a-kite" class="text-sm text-[#1d1916] hover:underline">What else can I do?</a></li><li><a href="#galleri" class="text-sm text-[#1d1916] hover:underline">Gallery</a></li><li><a href="#snokiteregler" class="text-sm text-[#1d1916] hover:underline">Snowkiting rules</a></li></ul></details><section id="nar-er-forholdene-best" class="py-10 md:py-12"><div class="grid items-start gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_320px]"><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-6 md:p-7"><h2 class="text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">When is the best time to come?</h2><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">There is often snow from late October to late May. We recommend visiting between February and April for longer daylight and the best snow conditions.</p><div class="mt-6 space-y-4"><div class="h-3 w-full bg-[#ddd5c8]"></div><div class="h-3 w-2/3 bg-[#8d6e46]"></div><div class="h-3 w-1/2 bg-[#5d7f94]"></div><p class="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[#6a645d]">Oct Nov Dec Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun</p></div></article><article bg-white p-6 md:order-1 md:p-7"><h2 class="text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">Local knowledge that makes your kite days better</h2><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">On Hardangervidda, conditions can change quickly. Small differences in wind direction, visibility and snow often decide whether the day becomes great or wasted.</p><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">When you stay with us, you get advice from people who are actually out there when it matters, with long experience from Hardangervidda. We are happy to share practical recommendations on spot choice, safety, wind and where to start the day.</p><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">Bjørn Kaupang, 6-time world champion and owner of the hotel, gives advice on where to go for the best kiting.</p><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">You can drive right to the door. Bed linen, towels and final cleaning are included. That makes it easier to prioritize more time outside and less logistics.</p><div class="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2"><span class="inline-flex border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] px-3 py-1 text-xs class="inline-flex border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-[#1d1916]">Comfort</span><span class="inline-flex border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-[#1d1916]">Less logistics</span></div><h3 class="mt-6 text-xl font-medium text-[#1d1916]">What you get when staying with app</a></div></article></div></section><section id="hvorfor-haugastol" class="py-10 md:py-12"><h2 class="text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">Why Haugastol?</h2><div class="mt-6 grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2"><article class="space-y-4 border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-6 md:p-7"></article><aside class="grid gap-4"><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] p-5"><h3 class="text-2xl font-medium text-[#1d1916]">Unlimited terrain</h3><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">A wide spread of spots across Hardangervidda and Hallingskarvet gives room to choose lines that match both level and conditions.</p></article><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] p-5"><h3 class="text-2xl font-medium text-[#1d1916]">Flexible and mobile</h3><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">The road access across the plateau makes it possible to move during the day and adapt to local wind and snow.</p></article><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] p-5"><h3 class="text-2xl font-medium text-[#1d1916]">Live conditions</h3><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">Weather stations and webcams from multiple areas make planning easier before and during each session.</p></article><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] p-5"><h3 class="text-2xl font-medium text-[#1d1916]">Strong snowkite history</h3><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">Haugastol has hosted major events and film productions over many seasons, with experienced local riders in the area.</p></article></aside></div><div class="mt-6 grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2"><article class="relative id="blaser-det-alltid" class="py-10 md:py-12"><div class="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_320px]"><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-6 md:p-7"><h2 class="text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">Is it always windy?</h2><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">NO! Luckily not! (read on to see why that&#x27;s actually an advantage!)</p><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">It goes without saying that when you travel somewhere to kite, you want wind.</p><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">But as many will have experienced, snow in areas where it&#x27;s always windy tends to be hard and icy. That&#x27;s great if you want to go fast, but most people prefer a softer surface.</p><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">So for the best chance of good snowkite days, it&#x27;s a big advantage to be in an area where the weather changes quickly and often. With Haugastøl&#x27;s position between two weather systems, you have twice the chance of days with good snow, wind and weather!</p><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">When snowkiting, you want a spot with powder, sun and wind.</p><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">If you stay at a spot where it is always windy, the snow will often be very hard. If you stay at a spot where it is always snowing, visibility will often be poor.</p><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">Hardangervidda has a unique microclimate where weather changes fast and is highly local, which is useful when you want the best possible snowkiting conditions.</p></article><aside class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] p-6 md:p-7"><div class="flex h-48 items-end gap-3"><div class="w-1/2"><div class="h-32 bg-[#8d6e46]"></div><p class="mt-2 text-center text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[#6a645d]">vind</p></div><div class="w-1/2"><div class="h-20 bg-[#6e90a2]"></div><p class="mt-2 text-center text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[#6a645d]">snø</p></div></div><div class="mt-3 flex justify-between text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[#6a645d]"><span>hard</span><span>myk</span></div></aside></div></section><section id="villrein-soner" class="py-10 md:py-12"><h2 class="text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">Reindeer and restrictions</h2><article class="mt-6 border border-[#c9b49a] bg-[#fff8ef] p-6 md:p-7"><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f] first:mt-0">On Hardangervidda there is a wild reindeer herd that must not be disturbed. Winter is the hardest time for the animals. We currently don&#x27;t have access to reindeer location data, so we can&#x27;t publish temporary no-kite zones. If you see reindeer or other wildlife, be considerate and calmly retreat; do not ride with or towards them. For full rules and temporary prohibited zones when available, see Oslo Kiteklubb&#x27;s snowkiting rules (link below).</p></article></section><section id="finnes-det-noe-annet-a-gjore-pa-haugastol-enn-a-kite" class="py-10 md:py-12"><h2 class="text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">What else can I do at Haugastøl besides kiting?</h2><div class="mt-6 grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_380px]"><article class="space-y-4 border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-6 md:p-7"><p class="text-[#4a453f]">If a good book by the fireplace, a session in the sauna or the latest episode of your favourite series on Netflix isn&#x27;t for you, there are plenty of other outdoor activities.</p><p class="text-[#4a453f]">We have cross-country skis and snowshoes for rent if you want to explore our two national parks.</p><p class="text-[#4a453f]">If you want to see spectacular nature, one of Norway&#x27;s most spectacular waterfalls, Vøringsfossen, is only 40 minutes&#x27; drive from Haugastøl. Another 20 minutes from Vøringsfossen and you&#x27;re down at the fjord.</p></article><aside class="grid gap-3"><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] p-4">A good book by the fireplace</article><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] p-4">A session in the sauna</article><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] p-4">Cross-country skis and snowshoes md:py-12"><h2 class="text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">Snowkiting rules</h2><p class="mt-4 max-w-3xl text-[#4a453f]">Oslo Kiteklubb publishes joint ground rules for snowkiting on Hardangervidda. Please follow them for your own safety and to protect wildlife and access.</p><ul class="mt-4 list-inside list-disc space-y-2 text-[#4a453f]"><li>Respect the wild reindeer herd and any temporary prohibited zones (see Oslo Kiteklubb for current zones when available).</li><li>Launch and land at least 150 m from the road, with the kite facing away from the road.</li><li>Do not fly the kite while crossing the road. Land the kite, cross on foot, then relaunch.</li><li>Do not jump over the road.</li><li>If the road is closed, check vegvesen.no or call 175; follow convoy rules and wait for an escort.</li></ul><p class="mt-6"><a href="https://www.oslokiteklubb.no/bli-en-kiter/snowkiting-rules/" class="font-medium text-[#1d1916] underline hover:no-underline" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Read the full snowkiting rules at Oslo Kiteklubb<!-- --> →</a></p></section><section class="py-10 md:py-12"><div class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-6 md:p-7"><div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3"><a
